% Packages and a class of the document found on TEXINPUTS, in a folder
% that a .latexmkrc's ensure_path or the environment adds, that read
% files named like tex4ht configuration files. Built as it is, the
% document finds none of them, and the page says so. run.mjs builds it
% again with each folder of test-texinpkg/ on TEXINPUTS, some of them
% copied to a folder whose name has a space, %, #, or '. As in the PDF,
% each case's text is in the page, and tex4ht reads no .4ht of the names
% the files give.
% - test-texinpkg-class.cls, a class on TEXINPUTS, when the folder has
%   one.
% - test-texinpkg-lib.sty, a package on TEXINPUTS, when the folder has
%   one. It defines \texinpkgtext, the case's text.
% - glossary.tex, read by the document with LaTeX's \input when the
%   package defines \texinpkgdocinput.
% index.4ht defines \printindex, and framed.4ht \a:makeframed, so the
% page shows when either was read: a sentence the PDF does not have.
\IfFileExists{test-texinpkg-class.cls}
  {\documentclass{test-texinpkg-class}}
  {\documentclass{article}}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\IfFileExists{test-texinpkg-lib.sty}{\usepackage{test-texinpkg-lib}}{}
\ifdefined\texinpkgdocinput \input{glossary}\fi
\providecommand\texinpkgtext{No package or class on TEXINPUTS.}
\begin{document}
\texinpkgtext
\ifdefined\printindex\par Index read for the web.\fi
\expandafter\ifx\csname a:makeframed\endcsname\relax\else\par Framed read for the web.\fi
\ifdefined\texinpkgextra\par\texinpkgextra\fi
\end{document}
